resources.string: Enter your server address
Your organization gives you the address. You can also paste an invite or message link.
Your organization has set up the server for this app.
Server address
team.example.com
Continue
Check that this is your organization\'s server before you sign in.
Continue to sign in
Use another server
Change server
Enter your server address.
That isn\'t a valid server address. Check it and try again.
Leave out the user name and password: enter only the server address.
Only secure (https) server addresses are supported.
There\'s no TeamCraft server at this address. Check the address with your admin.
Can\'t reach the server. Check the address and your connection, then try again.
You\'re offline. The app tries again as soon as you\'re connected.
Can\'t set up a secure connection to the server. Its certificate may be invalid, or the network is interfering.
This network wants you to sign in first, for example hotel or train Wi-Fi. Sign in to the network in your browser, then try again.
The server isn\'t available right now. Try again later.
This app is too old for the server. Update the app, then try again.
The server is too old for this app. Ask your admin to update it.
The server\'s sign-in settings are invalid. Ask your admin to check them.
The server isn\'t set up for this app yet. Ask your admin to allow the app\'s sign-in.
Your organization only allows its own server in this app.
Server address
The TeamCraft server users sign in to, for example https://team.example.com. The app checks it and asks the user to confirm before signing in.
Lock server
Users can\'t change to another server. An account on another server is signed out.
Trust company certificates
Also trust certificate authorities installed by the user or the device management, for example the CA of a proxy that inspects encrypted traffic. Off: only the system\'s CAs.
You will sign in at %1$s.
This server signs you in through %1$s, which is not part of its own domain. Continue only if your organization uses this sign-in service; otherwise someone could be impersonating your server.
